caption: The drawing shows a pair of light brown trousers with a textured, almost corduroy-like appearance. The trousers have buttons along the lower outer sides of each pant leg, as well as two suspenders or straps attached at the waist, with button fastenings at the front. There is a center seam running down from the waistband and the pants appear to have a high waist. The color ranges from tan to soft brown, with darker lines and shading to indicate folds or wrinkles in the fabric. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, less detailed sketch in pencil, which depicts the same trousers from the back view. The main drawing dominates the center of the page, and the name "Mary Humes" is written in small letters at the lower right corner. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Hunting Trousers
